liam_customer: Hey team — after the latest reranker rollout (around 03/12), our customer-facing search is returning fewer cited sources and some answers are hallucinating links. This started right after the deploy.
maya_cs: Sorry to hear that, liam. Can you paste a couple of example requests + responses where grounding dropped? Any request IDs would help.
liam_customer: Putting one sample here. We call /v1/retrieve -> /v1/rerank -> /v1/generate. Payload (trimmed):
```json
{
  "user_query": "Does AcmeHealth cover telemedicine for pre-existing conditions?",
  "top_k": 25,
  "reranker_model": "rerank-v3",
  "doc_ids": ["doc_3421", "doc_291"]
}
```
Response we got: short answer with no citations and a confident-sounding incorrect sentence referencing policy doc id that doesn't exist. Request ID: r-20260312-5f3a7c.
support-bot: Ticket #CS-4891 created and linked to internal tracking.
jon_eng_ml: Thanks — quick q: did you pin the retriever index to a specific embedding version? We changed the default embedding model for some tenants during the rollout (embed-v2-small -> embed-v3). If docs were indexed with embed-v2-small, scoring mismatch could drop recall.
liam_customer: We did a periodic index refresh on 03/10, so docs should still be embed-v2-small. We didn't re-index after your rollout.
nina_eng_platform: Noted. On our end, the rollout adjusted reranker weights and swapped the default reranker from rerank-v2 -> rerank-v3 for 60% of traffic at 03:05 UTC. No index reingest happened in the platform. Could be an embedding-model mismatch + reranker change.
alex_sre: Can you share the raw retriever top-k list and reranker scores for the failing request? Even a redacted snippet helps. Also, any latency or 5xx spikes around r-20260312-5f3a7c?
liam_customer: Top-k doc ids (ordered): doc_291, doc_3421, doc_99, doc_18. Reranker scores (v3): [0.12, 0.08, 0.07, 0.05]. Previously with v2 we saw more uniform spread and doc_3421 used to be top. I don't have raw logs for scores beyond this.
maya_cs: jon — could model tokenization/quantization changes in v3 reranker cause different relevance calibration? Also, were calibration transforms (score rescaling) updated in the rollout?
jon_eng_ml: Good call. We introduced a small temperature-like rescale in v3 to favor shorter documents for latency reasons. That could suppress long-but-relevant docs like doc_3421. It was supposed to be gated by tenant flag but appears enabled for some tenants due to a flag propagation issue.
nina_eng_platform: I'm checking the rollout flags now. Looks like a feature-flag targeting rule mis-evaluated for liam_customer's tenant id — they were included in the 60% cohort by mistake.
alex_sre: That explains behavior change. Action: temporarily route liam_customer traffic to rerank-v2 (rollback of flag) while we investigate score calibration and index/embedding mismatch.
liam_customer: Appreciate quick turnaround. How long to flip? We need this fixed for our morning peak.
nina_eng_platform: I can flip the flag now. ETA < 10m. Will post when done.
support-bot: Flag change executed: tenant routing for liam_customer -> rerank-v2. Change id: flag-ff-7721. Rolling out back to 100% of their requests.
maya_cs: After flag flip, please re-run the same request and paste the generate output + any new request ID.
liam_customer: Just tested — new request r-20260312-5f4b9e. Answer now includes proper citations and doc_3421 is top. Looks fixed for that sample. Thank you.
jon_eng_ml: Next steps: 1) We need to audit the rescaling tweak in rerank-v3 (disable or make opt-in per tenant). 2) Verify embedding-model compatibility for renter indices and surface reindex guidance in console. 3) Postmortem on flag propagation bug.
alex_sre: I'll collect SRE metrics for the rollout window (error rates, latency p50/p95) and attach to the ticket. @nina, can you add the change-run notes and the exact flag targeting predicate that failed?
nina_eng_platform: Adding now. Predicate used: tenant_id in cohort_60pct_v3. Bug was a stale cohort seed used during evaluation. Saved predicate: "tenant_hash % 100 < 60" but seed mismatch caused different mapping. I will create a follow-up to backfill audit logs for all tenants impacted.
liam_customer: Thanks team. A couple asks for the RCA: please include exact times, request samples, and whether any embedding reindex would be required to fully normalize ranking.
maya_cs: Will schedule a 1-hour RCA with liam and eng leads tomorrow. Ticket CS-4891 updated with action items.
support-bot: Reminder — SLA escalation timer set to 24h for this ticket.
jon_eng_ml: Also creating a small test harness to compare rerank-v2 vs rerank-v3 on a holdout set from liam_customer's corpus to quantify drift. Will share numbers in the RCA.
liam_customer: Good plan. Leaving the thread open for any follow-ups.
